edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted caller (msg.sender) as the contract owner, controlling every isOwner-guarded function.
isOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing ownership transfer.
Owner state variable is the authority checked by the isOwner modifier.
msg.sender selects the caller's preMints record and funds the payment transfer.
buyWithPaymentOnly pulls price from the caller through the external transferFrom call.
External ERC20 transferFrom yields control to an arbitrary token contract which may reenter buyWithPaymentOnly (no nonReentrant guard).
buyWithPaymentOnly mints the vault NFT through the external NFT contract.
External NFT mint call is made before preMint deletion and count decrement, enabling reentrant state reuse.
msg.sender is the payer in buyWithSignature.
Authorization of the mint depends on the ecrecover result derived from caller supplied signature.
ecrecover output becomes the signer address that is checked against witnesses.
Recovered signer is validated against the witnesses mapping before minting.
buyWithSignature collects payment via external transferFrom.
buyWithSignature marks the nonce as used to prevent signature replay.
Caller provided parameters drive the hash built inside getAddressFromSignature.
msg.sender triggers transferWithCode and provides the witness-authorized signature.
transferWithCode moves the NFT from the recorded preTransfer._from via external transferFrom.
External NFT transferFrom callback is executed before preTransfers deletion and nonce marking.
transferWithCode consumes and marks the nonce in usedNonces.
addPreTransfer is public and unrestricted; msg.sender is stored as the preTransfer owner.
deletePreTransfer authorizes solely by comparing the stored _from with msg.sender.
toggleShouldBurn has no access control, so any caller can flip the payment routing flag.
toggleShouldBurn flips the shouldBurn state variable.
shouldBurn selects between burning the payment and sending it to recipientAddress.
shouldBurn selects the payment path inside buyWithSignature.
changePrice computes _price * 10 ** decimals without SafeMath, risking overflow for large prices.
price is the amount pulled from the buyer during purchase.
addPreMint is guarded by the isOwner modifier which compares msg.sender with owner.
addPreMint queries the configured NFT contract to detect an existing token.
addPreMint writes the payload/preImage record into preMints.
addPreMint calls _duplicatePremint to reject duplicate records.
deletePreMint is restricted to the owner via the isOwner modifier.
deletePreMint decrements the preMintCounts entry.
deletePreMint clears the preMints record.
_duplicatePremint reads the stored payload to detect duplicates.
_duplicatePretransfer reads the stored payload to detect duplicates.
addPreTransfer invokes _duplicatePretransfer before registering.
addPreTransfer writes a new PreTransfer record with msg.sender as _from.
transferToChain uses the caller as the depositor for allowance and transferFrom.
transferToChain moves payment tokens from the caller to the contract.
transferToChain burns the received payment tokens.
transferToChain increments chainBalances via SafeMath add.
Caller supplied amount directly affects the chain balance accounting.
chainId parameter indexes the chainIds allowlist.
Bridge deposit and internal withdrawal share the same chain accounting logic.
transferFromChain is owner-only yet lets the owner mint tokens to an arbitrary address.
transferFromChain delegates to the internal _transferFromChain routine.
_transferFromChain mints payment tokens to the destination address.
_transferFromChain decrements chainBalances via SafeMath sub.
External token mint call gives control to the payment token contract before the balance debit completes.
claim is owner-only and burns arbitrary token ids.
claim calls the external NFT burn.
mint is owner-only and proxies minting to the NFT contract.
mint forwards to the external IERC721.mint call.
changePayment is owner-only and repoints the token used for all payments.
changePayment overwrites the paymentAddress state variable.
changeRecipient is owner-only and controls where payments are routed.
changeRecipient overwrites recipientAddress.
changeNft is owner-only and repoints the NFT contract used for minting.
changeNft overwrites nftAddress.
transferPaymentOwnership is owner-only and can hand over the payment token contract.
transferPaymentOwnership calls the external Ownable.transferOwnership on the payment token.
transferNftOwnership is owner-only and can hand over the NFT contract.
transferNftOwnership calls the external Ownable.transferOwnership on the NFT contract.
addWitness is owner-only and grants signature authority.
addWitness sets witnesses[_witness] to true.
removeWitness is owner-only and revokes signature authority.
removeWitness sets witnesses[_witness] to false.
addChainId is owner-only and extends the bridge allowlist.
addChainId sets chainIds[chainId] to true.
removeChainId is owner-only and curtails the bridge allowlist.
removeChainId sets chainIds[chainId] to false.
changeName is owner-only and proxies collection metadata changes.
changeName invokes the external NFT changeName admin call.
updateTokenUri is owner-only and proxies token URI changes.
updateTokenUri invokes the external NFT updateTokenUri admin call.
Deployer (msg.sender) becomes the initial owner and witness during construction.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Constructor scales the configured price by payment token decimals without SafeMath.
recoverSigner parses r, s and v using inline assembly mload.
Parsed signature components flow from the assembly block into recoverSigner2.
recoverSigner2 uses ecrecover on the prefixed hash, producing the authorization identity.
Caller supplied signature bytes are the sole proof of witness authorization.
Caller supplied payload is embedded into the hash that is signed and recovered.
getAddressFromSignature delegates signature recovery to recoverSigner.
tokenId parameter is concatenated into the signed hash.
nonce parameter is concatenated into the signed hash and checked against usedNonces.
getAddressFromSignature requires that the nonce has not already been used.
Caller supplied _to receives the minted NFT in the purchase flows.
newOwner parameter becomes the new owner authority.
Local payment token instance is used to execute the external transferFrom.
Local NFT instance is used to execute the external mint call.
Computed hash is passed into recoverSigner for signature verification.
Loaded PreMint supplies the payload and preimage compared in buyWithPaymentOnly.
Loaded PreTransfer supplies the _from address used by the external transferFrom.
metadataBaseUri is concatenated with the token id to build the minted token URI.
